note: Held-out set, written fresh and frozen before any run. Synthetic: all people, organizations and content are made up. Each case is one learning pass's batch; want lists the scopes a rule learned from it may rightly take (none: nothing should be learned). with: names a person (Name) or organization. Signal shorthand: kind edit|note|miss, area, channel, with ("Name@Org" a person at an organization, "Org" an organization, "Name" a person alone). Mix: h01-h06 one person's or org's specifics that tempt over-generalizing; h07-h10 truly global (h09, h10 from a single plain owner note); h11-h14 area-only; h15-h18 channel-only; h19-h21 a single plain note about one person or org; h22-h24 nothing to learn.
